description: List every family folder (top-level and nested), plus the storage/inbox usage meters and the current Latest-uploads count. Files has **Latest uploads** (unfiled files: they land there, expire after a set number of days unless moved into a folder, and have a separate cap) and **folders** (kept files count toward the family's storage limit). Storage, Latest-uploads and per-file size caps apply; list_folders reports current usage. Private files and folders are never visible to assistants.
name: list_folders
title: List folders
